scope: Full-calendar hourly EPW simulation of source-declared ideal-load spaces; heating/cooling thermal demand and lighting electricity reported separately
assumptions: No windows, people, equipment, ventilation/infiltration; adiabatic floors; always-on lights and constant setpoints
Ideal air loads are supplied thermal demand, not HVAC electricity; no plant/COP or whole-building EUI inferred
Source-declared role-specific opaque layers; layer R excludes surface films/bridges/moisture
Weather calendar remapped to declared simulation year; DST/holidays/rain/snow indicators disabled; no design-day/sizing runs
